string-array.name: speech_fresh
string-array.item: I could learn a new language right now.

string-array.name: speech_restless
string-array.item: So many tabs open in here!
My thoughts are scrolling by themselves. 😬

string-array.name: speech_fried
string-array.item: Do you smell something burning? It\'s me.

string-array.name: speech_hungry
string-array.item: Feed me something that isn\'t content.

string-array.name: speech_thirsty
string-array.item: Water, please. I\'m 75% water, you know. 💧
So thirsty… go drink some water too!

string-array.name: speech_tired
string-array.item: My battery is lower than yours.

string-array.name: speech_overstimulated
string-array.item: We\'ve been staring for ages. Blink with me?
Too many pixels. Need a break.

string-array.name: speech_near_limit
string-array.item: Heads up, we\'re almost at your limit.
Nearly there. Maybe stop on a good one?

string-array.name: speech_too_soon
string-array.item: Give me a moment to digest.

string-array.name: speech_blocked
string-array.item: We agreed on this limit. I\'m holding you to it.
Go outside. Touch grass. I\'ll wait. 🌱
One more reel won\'t feel better. Trust me.

string-array.name: speech_poked
string-array.item: Hey! Poking me won\'t unlock anything.
I\'m a brain, not a button.

string-array.name: speech_rested
string-array.item: Recharged! Thanks for putting me down.
